card.name: Link words in European history and literature
card.fires_on: Small linking words (into, by, of, when, drove) just before a named European historical or literary figure or work, mostly French or German history and opera/drama.

modes.label: Before a work or ruler
modes.description: A linking word right before the title of an adapted work or the name of a French ruler.
modes.example: Verdi transformed<< into>> La Forza del Destino ("The

modes.label: Dates in French revolutions
modes.description: Dates and numbering in lists of French uprisings and regime changes.
modes.example: February 24th, 1848, which<< drove>> Louis Philippe to abdicate and flee

modes.label: Authors and their works
modes.description: Possessive or "by" right after a famous author or work.
modes.example: The Two Foscari<< by>> Lord Byron and of an opera by Gi

card.writes: It pushes toward European personal names such as Corey, Hugo and Bang, and away from Apollo and Egyptian or pastoral terms.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in passages about European history, drama and opera, just before a name is expected.
